start.title: [TODO:it] The Crowd Follows
start.text:
[TODO:it] Thousands have climbed the hill.
They hunger for his every word.

send_away.title: [TODO:it] He Will Not Turn Them Away
send_away.text:
[TODO:it] His eyes hold the whole crowd.
None will leave empty.

rest_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Mercy First
rest_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Their hunger is his concern.
Stand ready beside him.

compassion.title: [TODO:it] Evening Falls
compassion.text:
[TODO:it] "They have nothing to eat."
The disciples murmur in fear.

count_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not by Silver
count_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Two hundred coins would not be enough.
Look with new eyes.

boy.title: [TODO:it] A Small Offering
boy.text:
[TODO:it] A boy lifts a humble basket.
Five loaves. Two small fish.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Faith places it in his hands.

dismiss_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Little Is Much
dismiss_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] In his hands, little is plenty.
Receive the boy's gift.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Honor the Gift
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His brave little heart deserves more.
Carry his basket gently.

bless.title: [TODO:it] He Lifts His Eyes
bless.text:
[TODO:it] He raises the bread to heaven.
A hush falls on the hillside.

unbelief_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay and See
unbelief_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The miracle begins in his hands.
Do not miss it.

distribute.title: [TODO:it] Pass It On
distribute.text:
[TODO:it] He breaks. He gives. He breaks again.
The baskets do not empty.

Keep no portion back.

feast.text:
[TODO:it] Families eat together on green grass.
No one rises hungry.

waste_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Every fragment is mercy made bread.
Let nothing be lost.

baskets.text:
[TODO:it] From a boy's gift, abundance overflows.
With little, he gives much.
